g.text: VIT A: high-dose campaigns 6–59 mo + night-blindness treatment + orange foods · IRON: pregnancy
tabs + child syrups + malaria/worms trio (M01!) · IODINE: iodised salt checks every visit · ZINC:
diarrhoea 10–14 days + ORS (M03/M06) · B12/D/calcium gaps in elders/vegans (GER/M01).
ASSESS: BMI + waist + BP + glucose/lipids + sleep/apnoea + joints + mood + diet/activity recall.
PLAN: 5–10% loss goal (transforms!) + plate (M04) + 150 min walk + Coke zero + sleep 7–8 h +
behaviour (eat slow, no screens, shop fed, small bowls) + family + review monthly. CHILDREN:
grow-into-weight (rarely diet!), active play 60 min + screens <2 h + breakfast + water + kind
words (teased children eat secretly — M03 image care!). Drugs/surgery: specialist only.
RE-FEEDING SYNDROME (feeding fast kills — GER M06!): RISK (starved >5 days, BMI
<16, >15% loss, alcoholism, SAM — last lesson!) → START LOW (~10 kcal/kg/day high-risk) +
THIAMINE before feeds + watch K+/Mg/PO4 + fluids careful + doctor-led + advance SLOWLY +
monitor (breathless? oedema? confused? seizures? — STOP + treat + call!). Applies: SAM F75
starts, hunger-strike rescue, post-op starved, neglected elders, anorexia care.
DOUBLE BURDEN (same house!): stunted child + obese mother + diabetic father — counsel the
KITCHEN once: shared rainbow plates + right portions each + walks together + Coke zero all.
Festivals + funerals: plan portions + dance + meds — joy kept, harm halved.
STIGMA-FREE WORDS: "weight" not "fat/obese-you"; "health gains" not "diet punishment"; praise
effort + centimetres + mmHg + energy ("stairs easier? sleeping better?") — scales lie daily,
trends tell monthly. Weigh private, counsel seated, listen first.
EATING DISORDERS (teens!): secret vomiting/laxatives/exercise, meal terror, over-exercise +
weight crash → kindly screen + medical check (K+/heart!) + refer (psych/counsellor) + family
support + follow — shame kills, care cures (M03 image link).
Document counsel + plans + reviews (PRO-I M5); audit clinic BMI/HbA1c trends (PRO-II M4) —
populations slim where nurses counsel kindly.
